```
      <view class="day-date">
        <view class="date-row">
          <text class="date-text">{{selectedDateText}}</text>
          <text class="task-count-text" wx:if="{{dayTasks.length > 0}}">{{dayTas
ks.length}}个任务</text>
          <!-- 改为标签式压力指示 -->
          <view class="pressure-tag pressure-level-{{selectedDayPressure.levelNu
m}}" wx:if="{{dayTasks.lengt
h > 0}}">
                                        <text>{{selectedDayPressure.levelText}}<
/text>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>
      <!-- 关闭按钮改为圆形X图标 -->
      <view class="close-btn-circle" bindtap="closeDayTasks">×</view>
    </view>
    <view class="tasks-list">
      <block wx:if="{{dayTasks.length > 0}}">
        <view 
          wx:for="{{dayTasks}}" 
          wx:key="id" 
          class="task-item {{item.status === 1 ? 'completed' : ''}} {{item.type}
}-task"
          id="task-{{item.id}}">
          <!-- 任务基本信息 -->
          <view class="task-item-row">
            <text class="task-title">{{item.title}}</text>
            <text class="task-description" wx:if="{{item.description}}">{{item.d
escription}}</text>
          </view>
          
          <!-- 任务操作区优化布局，移除描述图标 -->
          <view class="task-item-actions">
            <!-- 只保留任务编辑按钮 -->
            <view 
              class="task-edit-icon" 
              bindtap="showTaskEdit" 
              data-id="{{item.id}}"
              data-index="{{index}}">✎</view>
          </view>
        </view>
        
        <!-- 当日压力过高提示 -->
        <view class="pressure-warning" wx:if="{{selectedDayPressure.showWarning}
}">
          <text class="warning-icon">⚠️</text>
          <text class="warning-text">当日学习压力偏高，建议适当调整任务安排</text>
        </view>
      </block>
      <view class="empty-tasks" wx:else>
        <text>当日暂无任务</text>
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
  
  <!-- 循环任务范围提示气泡 -->
  <view class="scope-info-bubble {{showScopeInfoBubble ? 'visible' : ''}}" style
="{{scopeInfoStyle}}">
    <text class="bubble-text">将修改此循环任务的所有未来实例</text>
  </view>
  
  <!-- 压力指数说明弹窗 -->
  <view class="pressure-info-modal {{showPressureInfo ? 'visible' : ''}}" catcht
ap="hidePressureInfo">
    <view class="pressure-info-content" catchtap="preventClose">
      <view class="pressure-info-header">
        <text class="pressure-info-title">学习压力指数说明</text>
        <view class="pressure-info-close" bindtap="hidePressureInfo">×</view>
      </view>
      <view class="pressure-info-body">
        <view class="formula-section">
          <text class="formula-title">计算公式</text>
          <text class="formula-text">压力指数 = 任务基础压力 + 时长压力 + 积分压力</text>
        </view>
        <view class="factors-section">
          <text class="factors-title">影响因素</text>
          <view class="factor-item">
            <text class="factor-name">任务类型:</text>
            <text class="factor-desc">学习(×1.2) > 习惯(×0.8) > 兴趣(×0.6)</text>
          </view>
          <view class="factor-item">
            <text class="factor-name">时长影响:</text>
            <text class="factor-desc">每10分钟增加1点压力</text>
          </view>
          <view class="factor-item">
            <text class="factor-name">积分影响:</text>
            <text class="factor-desc">每20积分增加1点压力</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view class="levels-section">
          <text class="levels-title">压力级别</text>
          <view class="level-items">
            <view class="level-item level-1">轻松</view>
            <view class="level-item level-2">适中</view>
            <view class="level-item level-3">繁忙</view>
            <view class="level-item level-4">紧张</view>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>

```
